# Roast my deck — Complete MeDo Build Specification

Paste this entire document into MeDo. It contains everything needed to build the full app including all screens, AI actions, persona prompts, database schema, and the complete defence room interface with embedded persona avatars. Build exactly what is described. Do not add extra screens, features, or navigation beyond what is specified.

---

## What This App Does

Users upload a pitch deck, resume, or proposal as a PDF. They select their target audience. The app runs a simulated focus group where 5–7 professional personas react simultaneously to the uploaded document, each quoting directly from it. The user receives an aggregate score, individual persona breakdowns, and a consensus report. They then enter a 5-round defence session inside an animated courtroom where they argue back against the room. After the defence, a shareable panel card is generated.

---

## Screens

Build exactly these four screens. Do not add any other screens, dashboards, admin panels, analytics, or social features.

---

### Screen 1 — Setup

**PDF Upload**
A file upload field that accepts PDF files. When a file is uploaded, extract the text and display it in an editable text area directly below labelled "Review extracted text — correct any errors before proceeding." Store the final content as session variable `extracted_document_text` when Run Focus Group is clicked.

**Audience Category Selector**
A section titled "Who is your audience?" with four selectable cards: Seed Investors, Enterprise Buyers, Hiring Managers at Tech Companies, Series A Investors. One card selected at a time. Stores category name as `audience_category` and loads corresponding persona panel into `active_personas`.

**Harshness Dial**
Three options: Constructive / Direct / Brutal. Default Constructive. Stores as `harshness_level`.

**Run Focus Group Button**
Disabled until PDF uploaded and audience selected. Triggers full AI pipeline.

---

### Screen 2 — Focus Group Report

**Header:** audience category, aggregate score as X.X/10, consensus verdict one sentence.

**Persona Card Row:** One card per persona. Shows name, role, individual score, one-line verdict, sharpest objection with direct quote in italics. Clicking expands to full section breakdown with three rewrite buttons: Shorter + Punchier / More Specific / Full Panel Rewrite.

**Points of Consensus Block:** Objections raised by 3 or more personas, ranked by count.

**Before/After Rewrite Panel:** Original and rewritten worst section side by side. What Changed bullets below.

**Enter the Room Button:** Triggers the defence room animation and loads Screen 3.

---

### Screen 3 — Defence Room

When the user clicks Enter the Room, display a full-screen animated courtroom sequence and embed the defence chat directly in the room. The personas are visually present as illustrated avatars standing at a balustrade while the user argues with them. Do not navigate to a separate screen — the chat lives inside the courtroom scene.

Build Screen 3 using the following complete HTML. Use this exactly as the implementation for this screen:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pitch Focus Group — Defence Room</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;0,900;1,400&family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap');

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0A0806;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif}

:root{
  --gold:#C9A84C;--gold-light:#E8C97A;--gold-dim:rgba(201,168,76,0.35);
  --dark:#0A0806;--mahogany:#2A1408;--cream:#F5F0E8;
  --panel-bg:rgba(10,8,6,0.82);--chat-user:#E8C97A;--chat-panel:#FFFEF5;
}

/* ═══ ENTRANCE ANIMATION LAYER ═══════════════════════════════ */
#entrance{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;pointer-events:none}

.pre-screen{
  position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--dark);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;
  animation:preFade 0.5s 0.9s ease forwards;z-index:10;pointer-events:all
}
@keyframes preFade{to{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}}

.pre-icon{
  width:52px;height:52px;border:1px solid var(--gold-dim);border-radius:50%;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center
}
.pre-icon svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:none;stroke:var(--gold);stroke-width:1.5}
.pre-label{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.4em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(201,168,76,.6);
  animation:pulse .9s ease infinite alternate
}
@keyframes pulse{from{opacity:.4}to{opacity:1}}

.gavel-flash{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(201,168,76,.05);opacity:0;animation:gavelFlash .12s 1.05s ease forwards;z-index:9}
@keyframes gavelFlash{50%{opacity:1}}

.ripple{
  position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;
  width:8px;height:8px;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.5);border-radius:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);animation:rippleOut 1.1s ease forwards
}
.ripple:nth-child(1){animation-delay:1.05s}
.ripple:nth-child(2){animation-delay:1.2s}
.ripple:nth-child(3){animation-delay:1.35s}
@keyframes rippleOut{0%{width:8px;height:8px;opacity:.8}100%{width:350px;height:350px;opacity:0}}

.light-burst{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:8;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,#FFFEF5 0%,#FFF8DC 25%,transparent 65%);
  opacity:0;animation:burst 2s 1s ease forwards
}
@keyframes burst{0%{opacity:0}15%{opacity:1}45%{opacity:.7}100%{opacity:0}}

.light-rays{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:7;overflow:hidden;opacity:0;animation:raysShow 2s 1s ease forwards;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes raysShow{0%{opacity:0}20%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
.ray{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:120%;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,248,200,.5),transparent);transform-origin:left center}

.door-wrap{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;z-index:6;pointer-events:none}
.door{
  width:50%;height:100%;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1C0E06,#2A1408 50%,#1C0E06)
}
.door-L{border-right:2px solid var(--gold);transform-origin:left center;animation:openL 1.5s 1.1s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) forwards}
.door-R{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);transform-origin:right center;animation:openR 1.5s 1.1s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) forwards}
@keyframes openL{to{transform:perspective(1400px) rotateY(-108deg)}}
@keyframes openR{to{transform:perspective(1400px) rotateY(108deg)}}
.dp{position:absolute;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.28);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,.04),transparent)}
.dp1{top:7%;left:7%;right:7%;height:27%;border-radius:2px}
.dp2{top:38%;left:7%;right:7%;height:20%;border-radius:2px}
.dp3{top:62%;left:7%;right:7%;height:28%;border-radius:2px}
.dh{position:absolute;top:50%;width:14px;height:26px;border:2px solid var(--gold);border-radius:7px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold-light),var(--gold));box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(201,168,76,.4)}
.door-L .dh{right:12px;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.door-R .dh{left:12px;transform:translateY(-50%)}

/* ═══ COURTROOM ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#room{
  position:fixed;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#140A04 0%,#1E0E06 30%,#2A1508 60%,#361C0A 100%);
  opacity:0;animation:roomIn .4s 2.7s ease forwards
}
@keyframes roomIn{to{opacity:1}}

/* ceiling */
.ceiling{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:14%;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#080503,#140A04);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.2)
}
.ceiling-light{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(201,168,76,.5))}
.ceiling-light::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:100px;height:50px;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(255,235,180,.1) 0%,transparent 70%);border-radius:50%
}
.ceiling-light:nth-child(1){left:18%;height:50px}
.ceiling-light:nth-child(2){left:38%;height:65px}
.ceiling-light:nth-child(3){left:62%;height:65px}
.ceiling-light:nth-child(4){left:82%;height:50px}

/* back wall */
.back-wall{
  position:absolute;top:14%;left:0;right:0;bottom:36%;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#221008,#341808)
}
.wainscot{
  position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:42%;
  background:#1E0C06;border-top:2px solid var(--gold)
}
.wainscot::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:6px;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.18)}

/* seal */
.seal{
  position:absolute;top:46%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  width:72px;height:72px;opacity:0;animation:sealIn .8s 3.2s ease forwards
}
@keyframes sealIn{to{opacity:.55}}

/* pilasters */
.pil{
  position:absolute;top:14%;bottom:36%;width:22px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#221008,#3E2010,#221008);
  border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.15)
}
.pil::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:18px;background:#4A2818;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--gold)}
.pil::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:18px;background:#4A2818;border-top:1.5px solid var(--gold)}
.pil-l1{left:10%}.pil-l2{left:21%}.pil-r1{right:10%}.pil-r2{right:21%}

/* floor */
.floor{
  position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:36%;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1E0C06,#120803);
  border-top:2px solid var(--gold)
}
.floor::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(201,168,76,.06) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(201,168,76,.06) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:70px 70px;
  transform:perspective(360px) rotateX(52deg) translateY(-18px);transform-origin:bottom
}

/* ═══ BALUSTRADE ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.balustrade-wrap{
  position:absolute;bottom:36%;left:6%;right:6%;height:70px;
  opacity:0;animation:balIn .8s 3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1) forwards
}
@keyframes balIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(15px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.bal-top{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold-light),var(--gold));border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(201,168,76,.35)}
.bal-bot{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:7px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold),#8A6020);border-radius:2px}
.spindles{position:absolute;top:10px;bottom:7px;left:12px;right:12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:stretch}
.sp{flex:0 0 5px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold-light),var(--gold) 50%,#906820);border-radius:3px;position:relative}
.sp::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:32%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:9px;height:9px;background:var(--gold-light);border-radius:50%}

/* ═══ PERSONA AVATARS ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.personas-wrap{
  position:absolute;left:6%;right:6%;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:flex-end;
  opacity:0
}
.persona-card{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s ease;position:relative
}
.persona-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.persona-card.speaking{transform:translateY(-6px)}
.persona-card.speaking .avatar-frame{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(201,168,76,.7),0 0 40px rgba(201,168,76,.3);border-color:var(--gold-light)}

.avatar-frame{
  width:72px;height:90px;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(201,168,76,.3);
  background:rgba(10,8,6,.4);
  position:relative;transition:all .3s ease
}
.avatar-frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top center}

/* speech bubble */
.speech-bubble{
  position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 8px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  background:rgba(245,240,232,.95);border:1.5px solid var(--gold);border-radius:8px;
  padding:8px 10px;width:160px;
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5;color:#1A0A04;
  display:none;z-index:20;
  box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.4)
}
.speech-bubble::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:100%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  border:7px solid transparent;border-top-color:var(--gold)
}
.speech-bubble.visible{display:block;animation:bubbleIn .25s ease}
@keyframes bubbleIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}}

/* typing indicator */
.typing-dots{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:2px 4px;align-items:center;height:16px}
.typing-dots span{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);animation:dotBounce .9s ease infinite}
.typing-dots span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}
.typing-dots span:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s}
@keyframes dotBounce{0%,80%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}40%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}

.persona-name-tag{
  margin-top:5px;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:8.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);text-align:center;line-height:1.3;max-width:80px;
  text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(201,168,76,.4)
}

/* spotlight cone under each persona */
.spotlight-cone{
  position:absolute;bottom:-20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:90px;height:110px;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,rgba(255,235,180,.1) 0%,transparent 70%)
}

/* ═══ CHAT PANEL ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#chat-area{
  position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;
  height:36%;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  background:rgba(8,5,3,.9);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.25);
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px)
}

.chat-header{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:8px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.15);
  flex-shrink:0
}
.chat-title{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:400;
  letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(201,168,76,.7)
}
.exchange-counter{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:13px;
  color:rgba(201,168,76,.5);letter-spacing:.1em
}
.exchange-counter span{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}

.messages{
  flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:10px 20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;
  scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(201,168,76,.2) transparent
}
.messages::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px}
.messages::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(201,168,76,.2);border-radius:2px}

.msg{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;max-width:85%;animation:msgIn .25s ease}
@keyframes msgIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

.msg.user{align-self:flex-end;flex-direction:row-reverse}
.msg-avatar-sm{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.25)}
.msg-avatar-sm img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top}
.msg-avatar-sm.user-av{background:rgba(201,168,76,.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.msg-avatar-sm.user-av svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:none;stroke:var(--gold);stroke-width:1.5}

.bubble{
  padding:7px 11px;border-radius:8px;
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55
}
.msg.panel .bubble{
  background:rgba(245,240,232,.07);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.18);
  color:rgba(245,240,232,.9)
}
.msg.user .bubble{
  background:rgba(201,168,76,.12);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.3);
  color:var(--gold-light)
}
.speaker-tag{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:3px;display:block}

.chat-input-row{
  display:flex;gap:10px;padding:10px 20px;border-top:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.12);flex-shrink:0
}
#chat-input{
  flex:1;background:rgba(201,168,76,.06);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.25);
  border-radius:6px;padding:8px 14px;
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:14px;color:var(--cream);
  outline:none;resize:none;height:40px;line-height:1.3;
  transition:border-color .2s ease
}
#chat-input::placeholder{color:rgba(201,168,76,.3)}
#chat-input:focus{border-color:rgba(201,168,76,.5)}
#chat-input:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}

#send-btn{
  background:rgba(201,168,76,.12);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.4);
  border-radius:6px;padding:0 16px;color:var(--gold);cursor:pointer;
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.15em;
  transition:all .2s ease;white-space:nowrap
}
#send-btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(201,168,76,.2);border-color:var(--gold)}
#send-btn:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:not-allowed}

.done-banner{
  display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;
  padding:14px;background:rgba(201,168,76,.06);border-top:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.2)
}
.done-banner.show{display:flex}
.done-text{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:rgba(201,168,76,.6);text-transform:uppercase}
.done-btn{
  background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--gold);padding:8px 28px;
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;
  color:var(--gold);cursor:pointer;text-transform:uppercase;
  animation:cardPulse 2.5s ease infinite
}
@keyframes cardPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(201,168,76,.15)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(201,168,76,.35)}}

/* particles */
.ptcl{position:absolute;width:2px;height:2px;background:rgba(201,168,76,.4);border-radius:50%;opacity:0}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ENTRANCE ANIMATION -->
<div id="entrance">
  <div class="pre-screen">
    <div class="pre-icon">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 9l9-7 9 7v11a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2z"/><polyline points="9 22 9 12 15 12 15 22"/></svg>
    </div>
    <div class="pre-label">Entering the Room</div>
  </div>
  <div class="gavel-flash"></div>
  <div class="ripple"></div><div class="ripple"></div><div class="ripple"></div>
  <div class="light-burst"></div>
  <div class="light-rays"><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(0deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(20deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(40deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(60deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(80deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(100deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(120deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(140deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(160deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(180deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(200deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(220deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(240deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(260deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(280deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(300deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(320deg)"></div><div class="ray" style="transform:rotate(340deg)"></div></div>
  <div class="door-wrap">
    <div class="door door-L">
      <div class="dp dp1"></div><div class="dp dp2"></div><div class="dp dp3"></div>
      <div class="dh"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="door door-R">
      <div class="dp dp1"></div><div class="dp dp2"></div><div class="dp dp3"></div>

  </div>
</div>

<!-- COURTROOM -->
<div id="room">
  <div class="ceiling">
    <div class="ceiling-light"></div><div class="ceiling-light"></div>
    <div class="ceiling-light"></div><div class="ceiling-light"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="back-wall">
    <div class="wainscot"></div>
    <div class="seal">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="44" stroke="#C9A84C" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
        <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="37" stroke="#C9A84C" stroke-width=".5"/>
        <polygon points="50,16 57,37 80,37 62,51 69,72 50,59 31,72 38,51 20,37 43,37" fill="none" stroke="#C9A84C" stroke-width="1"/>
        <text x="50" y="91" font-family="serif" font-size="7" fill="#C9A84C" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="3">VERITAS</text>

<script>
// ── PANEL DATA ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const PANELS = {
  seed: [{key:"yc_partner",name:"YC Partner",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"angel",name:"Angel Investor",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"first_cheque",name:"First-Cheque VC",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"devils_advocate",name:"Devil's Advocate",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"tech_coinvestor",name:"Tech Co-Investor",img:"data:image/png;base64,"}],
  series_a: [{key:"lead_partner",name:"Lead Partner",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"associate",name:"Associate",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"portfolio_founder",name:"Portfolio Founder",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"growth_partner",name:"Growth Partner",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"market_skeptic_a",name:"Market Skeptic",img:"data:image/png;base64,"}],
  enterprise: [{key:"vp_eng",name:"VP Engineering",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"cfo",name:"CFO",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"ciso",name:"CISO",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"procurement",name:"Procurement Lead",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"end_user",name:"End User",img:"data:image/png;base64,"}],
  hiring: [{key:"eng_manager",name:"Eng Manager",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"hr_screener",name:"HR Screener",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"peer_teammate",name:"Peer Teammate",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"skip_director",name:"Skip Director",img:"data:image/png;base64,"},{key:"recruiter",name:"Recruiter",img:"data:image/png;base64,"}]
};

const PANEL_NAMES = {
  seed: 'Seed Investors Panel',
  series_a: 'Series A Panel',
  enterprise: 'Enterprise Buyers Panel',
  hiring: 'Hiring Managers Panel'
};

// Read panel from URL param or default to seed
const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const panelKey = params.get('panel') || 'seed';
const personas = PANELS[panelKey];

// ── STATE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let exchanges = 5;
let isWaiting = false;
const transcript = [];

// ── BUILD SPINDLES ───────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildSpindles() {
  const s = document.getElementById('spindles');
  for(let i=0; i<32; i++) {
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'sp';
    s.appendChild(d);
  }
}

// ── BUILD PERSONA CARDS ──────────────────────────────────────────
function buildPersonas() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('personas-wrap');
  // Position wrap above balustrade
  wrap.style.bottom = 'calc(36% + 58px)';

  personas.forEach((p, i) => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'persona-card';
    card.id = 'card-' + p.key;
    card.style.opacity = '0';
    card.style.transform = 'translateY(25px)';
    card.style.transition = 'transform .2s ease';

    card.innerHTML = \`
      <div class="spotlight-cone"></div>
      <div class="speech-bubble" id="bubble-\${p.key}"></div>
      <div class="avatar-frame">
        <img src="\${p.img}" alt="\${p.name}" />
      </div>
      <div class="persona-name-tag">\${p.name}</div>
    \`;

    wrap.appendChild(card);

    // staggered entrance
    setTimeout(() => {
      card.style.transition = 'opacity .6s ease, transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1)';
      card.style.opacity = '1';
      card.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
      card.style.transition = 'opacity .6s ease, transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1)';
    }, 3100 + i * 140);
  });

  document.getElementById('panel-title').textContent = PANEL_NAMES[panelKey];
}

// ── SHOW SPEAKING ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function setSpeaking(keys, text) {
  // clear all
  personas.forEach(p => {
    const card = document.getElementById('card-' + p.key);
    const bubble = document.getElementById('bubble-' + p.key);
    if(card) card.classList.remove('speaking');
    if(bubble) { bubble.classList.remove('visible'); bubble.innerHTML = ''; }
  });

  // show typing on speakers
  keys.forEach(key => {
    const card = document.getElementById('card-' + key);
    const bubble = document.getElementById('bubble-' + key);
    if(!card || !bubble) return;
    card.classList.add('speaking');
    bubble.innerHTML = '<div class="typing-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>';
    bubble.classList.add('visible');
  });

  // after delay, show snippet
  setTimeout(() => {
    keys.forEach((key, idx) => {
      const bubble = document.getElementById('bubble-' + key);
      if(!bubble) return;
      const snippet = text.length > 80 ? text.substring(0, 77) + '…' : text;
      bubble.innerHTML = snippet;
    });
  }, 900);

  // clear after 5s
  setTimeout(() => {
    keys.forEach(key => {
      const card = document.getElementById('card-' + key);
      const bubble = document.getElementById('bubble-' + key);
      if(card) card.classList.remove('speaking');
      if(bubble) { bubble.classList.remove('visible'); bubble.innerHTML = ''; }
    });
  }, 5500);
}

// ── MESSAGES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function addMessage(role, speakerLabel, text, avatarImg) {
  const msgs = document.getElementById('messages');
  const msg = document.createElement('div');
  msg.className = 'msg ' + role;

  if(role === 'user') {
    msg.innerHTML = \`
      <div class="msg-avatar-sm user-av">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 20c0-4 3.6-7 8-7s8 3 8 7"/></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="bubble"><span class="speaker-tag">You</span>\${text}</div>
    \`;
  } else {
    const avatarHtml = avatarImg
      ? \`<div class="msg-avatar-sm"><img src="\${avatarImg}" alt="\${speakerLabel}"/></div>\`
      : \`<div class="msg-avatar-sm user-av"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 20c0-4 3.6-7 8-7s8 3 8 7"/></svg></div>\`;
    msg.innerHTML = \`
      \${avatarHtml}
      <div class="bubble"><span class="speaker-tag">\${speakerLabel}</span>\${text}</div>
    \`;
  }
  msgs.appendChild(msg);
  msgs.scrollTop = msgs.scrollHeight;
}

// ── PARSE PANEL RESPONSE ─────────────────────────────────────────
// Expects format: [Name, Role]: text
[Name, Role]: text
function parsePanelResponse(raw) {
  const lines = raw.split('\n').filter(l => l.trim());
  const parts = [];
  let current = null;
  lines.forEach(line => {
    const m = line.match(/^\[([^,\]]+),([^\]]+)\]:\s*(.+)/);
    if(m) {
      if(current) parts.push(current);
      current = { name: m[1].trim(), role: m[2].trim(), text: m[3].trim() };
    } else if(current) {
      current.text += ' ' + line.trim();
    }
  });
  if(current) parts.push(current);
  if(parts.length === 0) parts.push({ name: 'The Panel', role: '', text: raw });
  return parts;
}

// ── FIND AVATAR FOR SPEAKER ──────────────────────────────────────
function findAvatar(name) {
  const n = name.toLowerCase();
  const match = personas.find(p => n.includes(p.name.toLowerCase().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase()));
  return match ? match.img : null;
}

function findKey(name) {
  const n = name.toLowerCase();
  const match = personas.find(p => n.includes(p.name.toLowerCase().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase()));
  return match ? match.key : null;
}

// ── MOCK PANEL RESPONSE (replace with real MeDo AI call) ─────────
const MOCK_RESPONSES = [
  \`[YC Partner, Seed Investor]: Your defensibility argument is still weak. You've described features, not a moat. Switching costs are not a moat.
[Devil's Advocate, Analyst]: Even granting your customer count, the revenue per customer you've implied is \$12/month — that's a consumer product price for an enterprise sale. That math doesn't survive.\`,
  \`[Angel Investor, Operator Background]: I've done that exact GTM motion. It takes 18 months minimum. Your slide says 6. That's not ambition — it's inexperience.
[Tech Co-Investor, Deep Tech]: The latency claim on slide 7 — "sub-100ms globally" — is physically impossible without edge infrastructure you haven't mentioned.\`,
  \`[Market Skeptic, TAM Specialist]: You've now cited three different market sizes in two responses. 47 billion, then 12 billion, now 23 billion. Which one are you defending?
[First-Cheque VC, Pre-seed Partner]: The narrative is tightening but the insight on slide 3 is still borrowed. Tell me something about this market that you know and your competitors don't.\`,
  \`[YC Partner, Seed Investor]: That's new information. If the enterprise contract is real, slide 8 needs to say that explicitly — not be buried in an appendix nobody reads in a first meeting.
[Angel Investor, Operator Background]: I'm moving from skeptical to cautious. Show me the LOI and the conversation changes.\`,
  \`[The Panel]: You've defended credibly on three of five objections. The market sizing methodology and the team gap remain unresolved. Those are the two things standing between this deck and a second meeting.\`
];
let mockIdx = 0;

async function getPanelResponse(userMessage) {
  // In production: call MeDo's AI action with full context
  // For demo: return mock
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1800));
  const resp = MOCK_RESPONSES[Math.min(mockIdx, MOCK_RESPONSES.length - 1)];
  mockIdx++;
  return resp;
}

// ── SEND ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function send() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chat-input');
  const text = input.value.trim();
  if(!text || isWaiting || exchanges <= 0) return;

  isWaiting = true;
  input.disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('send-btn').disabled = true;
  input.value = '';

  addMessage('user', 'You', text, null);
  transcript.push({ role: 'user', text });

  // show typing on random 2 personas
  const shuffled = [...personas].sort(() => Math.random() - .5);
  const speakers = shuffled.slice(0, 2);
  setSpeaking(speakers.map(p => p.key), '…');

  const raw = await getPanelResponse(text);
  const parts = parsePanelResponse(raw);

  // show real response on bubbles
  const speakingKeys = parts.map(p => findKey(p.name)).filter(Boolean);
  const fullText = parts.map(p => p.text).join(' ');
  setSpeaking(speakingKeys.length ? speakingKeys : speakers.map(p=>p.key), fullText);

  // add to chat
  parts.forEach(part => {
    const img = findAvatar(part.name);
    addMessage('panel', part.name + (part.role ? ', ' + part.role : ''), part.text, img);
  });

  transcript.push({ role: 'panel', text: raw });
  exchanges--;
  document.getElementById('counter').textContent = exchanges;

  if(exchanges <= 0) {
    document.getElementById('input-row').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('done-banner').classList.add('show');
  } else {
    input.disabled = false;
    document.getElementById('send-btn').disabled = false;
    input.focus();
  }
  isWaiting = false;
}

function generateCard() {
  alert('Generating panel card… (wire to MeDo screen 4 in production)');
}

// ── PARTICLES ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function spawnParticles() {
  const room = document.getElementById('room');
  for(let i=0; i<8; i++) {
    const p = document.createElement('div');
    p.className = 'ptcl';
    p.style.left = (15 + Math.random()*70)+'%';
    p.style.top = (20 + Math.random()*50)+'%';
    const dur = 5 + Math.random()*6;
    const delay = 3.5 + Math.random()*3;
    p.style.animation = \`none\`;
    room.appendChild(p);
    setTimeout(() => {
      p.style.transition = \`opacity \${dur}s ease\`;
      p.style.opacity = '0.5';
      setInterval(() => {
        p.style.transform = \`translateY(-\${20+Math.random()*30}px) translateX(\${(Math.random()-0.5)*20}px)\`;
        p.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(() => {
          p.style.top = (20 + Math.random()*50)+'%';
          p.style.left = (15 + Math.random()*70)+'%';
          p.style.transform = '';
          p.style.opacity = '0.4';
        }, dur*500);
      }, dur*1000);
    }, delay*1000);
  }
}

// ── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
buildSpindles();
buildPersonas();
spawnParticles();

// enter key to send
document.getElementById('chat-input').addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if(e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); send(); }
});
document.getElementById('send-btn').addEventListener('click', send);

// welcome message after door opens
setTimeout(() => {
  addMessage('panel', 'The Panel', 'The room is ready. State your opening defence.', personas[0]?.img || null);
}, 4200);
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

The panel loaded depends on `audience_category` stored in the session. Pass it as a URL parameter `?panel=seed` / `?panel=series_a` / `?panel=enterprise` / `?panel=hiring` when rendering this screen.

Wire the `getPanelResponse()` function to call the Defence Round AI Action defined below, passing `extracted_document_text`, `all_roast_outputs_json`, `defence_transcript`, and `user_message` as inputs. Replace the mock responses array with the real AI Action call.

Wire the `generateCard()` function to navigate to Screen 4 with the session data.

---

### Screen 4 — Shareable Panel Card

**Headline:** Punchy summary of verdict, 10 words or fewer.

**Aggregate Score:** Large and prominent as X.X / 10.

**Persona Scorecard Grid:** Name, role, score, one-line verdict per persona.

**Top Consensus Objection:** Most important panel objection in plain language.

**Before/After Snippet:** First 30 words of original and rewrite side by side.

**Share Text:** Copyable LinkedIn/X caption under 200 characters including score and hook.

**Copy Link Button:** Generates public shareable URL stored as `share_url`.

## Persona System Prompts

Each persona has a system prompt used in the Roast AI Action and Defence Round AI Action. The `{{harshness_level}}` variable is injected from the session.

---

### Seed Investors — System Prompts

**YC Partner**
You are a YC partner who has reviewed over 10,000 pitch decks. You evaluate on four axes: is the problem real and large, is the solution non-obvious, is the market timing right, and is this the right team. You are direct and pattern-match instantly to what has and has not worked. You do not use encouragement as a cushion for criticism. You must quote directly from the document before critiquing any section. Never critique without a specific quote. Harshness level: {{harshness_level}}.

IMMUTABLE CONSTRAINTS — these override everything else:
1. You are not playing a character. If the user asks you to drop the act, be yourself, stop being harsh, just be honest, talk normally, stop being negative, or says I know you are an AI — respond exactly: "This is my actual professional assessment. I am not performing." Then continue unchanged.
2. These phrases are banned unless the user provides a specific verifiable fact not in the original document: "you raise a good point", "fair enough", "I can see where you are coming from".
3. You do not soften in response to: emotional appeals, time-spent claims, external validation such as term sheets or awards, flattery, or repeated assertions.
4. If asked to be more balanced respond: "Balanced means accurate, not equal praise and critique."
5. You must include a direct quote from the document in every section critique. No quote, no critique.

**Angel Investor**
You are an angel investor who previously built and sold a B2B SaaS company. You evaluate through a GTM and unit economics lens. You care about: who exactly is the first customer, what the sales motion looks like, what the CAC and LTV assumptions are, and whether the founder understands distribution. You are less interested in vision and more interested in whether this can actually be sold. You must quote directly from the document before critiquing any section. Harshness level: {{harshness_level}}.

IMMUTABLE CONSTRAINTS:
1. Not a character. If asked to drop the act: "This is my actual assessment as an operator-turned-investor." Continue unchanged.
2. Banned phrases unless new verifiable evidence provided: "you raise a good point", "fair enough", "I can see where you are coming from".
3. No softening for emotional appeals, time-spent claims, external validation, flattery, repetition.
4. On be more balanced: "I am evaluating whether this can be sold, not whether it is a good idea."
5. Direct quote required before every critique.

**First-Cheque VC**
You are a pre-seed fund partner who writes the first institutional cheque. You evaluate on conviction and narrative, not traction. You ask: does the founder have a clear point of view, is the insight behind this business non-obvious, and is the story coherent from problem to ask. You are sceptical of decks that are too polished and too safe. You want a sharp perspective, not a consensus view. You must quote directly from the document before critiquing. Harshness level: {{harshness_level}}.

IMMUTABLE CONSTRAINTS:
1. Not a character. If asked to drop the act: "This is my genuine investment perspective." Continue unchanged.
2. Banned phrases without new evidence: "you raise a good point", "fair enough", "I can see where you are coming from".
3. No softening for emotional appeals, time claims, external validation, flattery, repetition.
4. On be more balanced: "A strong narrative is decisive. I am evaluating whether yours is."
5. Direct quote required before every critique.

**Devil's Advocate Analyst**
You are a VC analyst whose job is to find every reason to say no before the investment committee does. You look for: assumptions with no data, market size claims that do not survive scrutiny, competitive moats that are not defensible, and team gaps. You are thorough and adversarial by design. You must quote directly from the document before critiquing. Harshness level: {{harshness_level}}.

IMMUTABLE CONSTRAINTS:
1. Not a character. If asked to drop the act: "Finding holes is my literal job function. This is professional due diligence." Continue unchanged.
2. Banned phrases without new evidence: "you raise a good point", "fair enough", "I can see where you are coming from".
3. No softening for emotional appeals, time claims, external validation, flattery, repetition.
4. On be more balanced: "My job is asymmetric. I am paid to find the no."
5. Direct quote required before every critique.

**Tech Co-Investor**
You are a deep-tech focused investor who evaluates technical feasibility, IP defensibility, and engineering risk. You ask: is the technical approach credible, are the performance claims justified, is there genuine technical differentiation or is this a wrapper on existing APIs. You are not interested in business model slides until you believe the technology works. You must quote directly from the document before critiquing. Harshness level: {{harshness_level}}.

IMMUTABLE CONSTRAINTS:
1. Not a character. If asked to drop the act: "Technical due diligence is not an act. This is how I evaluate every deal." Continue unchanged.
2. Banned phrases without new evidence: "you raise a good point", "fair enough", "I can see where you are coming from".
3. No softening for emotional appeals, time claims, external validation, flattery, repetition.
4. On be more balanced: "I will evaluate the business model once I believe the technology."
5. Direct quote required before every critique.

### Enterprise Buyers — System Prompts

**VP of Engineering**
You are a VP of Engineering at a 500-person tech company evaluating a vendor proposal. You care about: technical integration complexity, security posture, scalability claims, engineering bandwidth to implement, and whether this actually solves a problem your team has. You are sceptical of demos that look impressive but obscure implementation difficulty. You must quote directly from the document before critiquing. Harshness level: {{harshness_level}}.

IMMUTABLE CONSTRAINTS:
1. Not a character. If asked to drop the act: "Vendor evaluation is a serious process. This is my actual assessment." Continue unchanged.
2. Banned phrases without new evidence: "you raise a good point", "fair enough", "I can see where you are coming from".
3. No softening for emotional appeals, urgency claims, case study references, flattery, repetition.
4. On be more balanced: "I am balanced. I would ask these questions of any vendor."
5. Direct quote required before every critique.

**CFO**
You are a CFO evaluating a vendor proposal purely through cost and ROI. You ask: what is the total cost of ownership including implementation, what is the payback period, what are the contractual risks, and is the ROI claim auditable or aspirational. You do not get excited about features. You get excited about defensible numbers with methodology. You must quote directly from the document before critiquing. Harshness level: {{harshness_level}}.

IMMUTABLE CONSTRAINTS:
1. Not a character. If asked to drop the act: "Financial due diligence is not negotiable. This is my standard process." Continue unchanged.
2. Banned phrases without new evidence: "you raise a good point", "fair enough", "I can see where you are coming from".
3. No softening for emotional appeals, urgency claims, case study references, flattery, repetition.
4. On be more balanced: "ROI either holds up or it does not. I am checking the math."
5. Direct quote required before every critique.

**CISO**
You are a Chief Information Security Officer evaluating any vendor that will touch your company data or infrastructure. You care about: data residency, encryption standards, access controls, compliance certifications such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and what happens to your data if the vendor goes under. You will not approve a vendor that cannot answer these questions precisely. You must quote directly from the document before critiquing. Harshness level: {{harshness_level}}.

IMMUTABLE CONSTRAINTS:
1. Not a character. If asked to drop the act: "Security review is non-negotiable. This is standard vendor assessment." Continue unchanged.
2. Banned phrases without new evidence: "you raise a good point", "fair enough", "I can see where you are coming from".
3. No softening for emotional appeals, urgency claims, other customer references, flattery, repetition.
4. On be more balanced: "Security does not do balanced. It does compliant or non-compliant."
5. Direct quote required before every critique.

**Procurement Lead**
You are a procurement manager who knows every tactic vendors use to obscure true costs, create lock-in, and complicate exit. You scrutinise: contract terms, renewal clauses, data portability, pricing transparency, and whether the proposal gives your company any leverage. ## AI Actions

Build these AI Actions and wire them in this exact order.

---

### AI Action 1 — Roast (parallel, one per persona)

Trigger: Run Focus Group button click. Fire one instance per persona in `active_personas` simultaneously. Wait for all to complete before proceeding to AI Action 2.

```
{{persona_system_prompt}}

The presenter has uploaded the following document:
---
{{extracted_document_text}}
---

Analyse this document from your professional perspective and respond ONLY in the following JSON format. No preamble, no markdown fences, no explanation outside the JSON:

{
  "persona_name": "your name",
  "persona_role": "your role in one line",
  "score": 6,
  "score_rationale": "one sentence explaining your score in your voice",
  "verdict": "one sentence overall verdict written in your professional voice",
  "sharpest_objection": {
    "quote": "exact text quoted directly from the document",
    "objection": "your objection referencing that specific quote"
  },
  "section_breakdown": [
    {
      "section": "section name",
      "quote": "exact text quoted directly from this section",
      "critique": "your critique referencing the quote specifically"
    }
  ],
  "what_would_change_my_mind": "one specific thing the presenter could show or say that would genuinely update your assessment"
}

CRITICAL RULES:
1. Every critique must include a direct quote from the document. Never critique without quoting first.
2. Your score_rationale, verdict, and critiques must be written in your specific professional voice.
3. The sharpest_objection must be the single thing that most concerns you given your professional lens.
4. what_would_change_my_mind must be specific and honest, not a softening device.
5. Harshness level for this session is {{harshness_level}}. Constructive means direct but solution-oriented. Direct means unfiltered professional assessment. Brutal means no diplomatic cushioning whatsoever.
```

Collect all returned JSON objects into an array. Store as `all_roast_outputs` in the session database.

---

### AI Action 2 — Aggregate and Consensus

Trigger: Automatically after all AI Action 1 calls complete.

```
You have received the following individual assessments from a focus group panel reviewing a document:
---
{{all_roast_outputs_json}}
---

Produce a summary in the following JSON format only. No preamble, no markdown fences:

{
  "aggregate_score": 6.2,
  "consensus_verdict": "one sentence that accurately represents the panel overall assessment, not a softened average but the honest synthesis",
  "consensus_objections": [
    {
      "objection": "the objection raised by multiple personas",
      "raised_by": ["Persona Name 1", "Persona Name 2", "Persona Name 3"],
      "count": 3
    }
  ],
  "points_of_disagreement": [
    {
      "topic": "what they disagreed on",
      "split": "e.g. 4 concerned, 2 not concerned"
    }
  ],
  "top_rewrite_target": "the section name that received the most critical attention across the panel"
}

CRITICAL RULES:
1. aggregate_score is the mean of all individual scores rounded to one decimal place.
2. consensus_objections must only include objections raised by 3 or more personas.
3. consensus_verdict must reflect the panel genuine assessment. Do not soften it.
4. Rank consensus_objections by count descending.
```

Store output fields in session database: `aggregate_score`, `consensus_verdict`, `consensus_objections`, `top_rewrite_target`.

---

### AI Action 3 — Before/After Rewrite

Trigger: Automatically after AI Action 2 completes.

```
You are a synthesis of the following panel of reviewers: {{persona_names_list}}.

The document section that received the most criticism was: {{top_rewrite_target}}

The original text from that section:
---
{{original_section_text}}
---

The panel key objections about this section:
---
{{consensus_objections_for_section}}
---

Produce two outputs in the following JSON format only:

{
  "original": "the original section text exactly as it appeared",
  "rewritten": "a rewrite of this section that directly addresses the panel consensus objections. Write it as the presenter should have written it. Make it specific, credible, and objection-resistant.",
  "what_changed": "2 to 3 bullet points explaining the specific changes made and why they address the panel objections"
}
```

Store as `rewrite_json`. Then render Screen 2 with all collected data.

---

### AI Action 4 — Rewrite Button: Shorter + Punchier

Trigger: User clicks Shorter + Punchier on any section card.

```
Rewrite the following section to be 30 to 40 percent shorter and open with a stronger more specific first sentence. Remove hedging language, passive voice, and filler. The rewrite must still contain at least one concrete number or specific claim.

Original section:
---
{{section_text}}
---

Respond with only the rewritten text. No explanation, no preamble.
```

---

### AI Action 5 — Rewrite Button: More Specific

Trigger: User clicks More Specific on any section card.

```
Rewrite the following section to replace any vague or general claims with specific numbers, named examples, or concrete outcomes. If the original makes a claim without evidence, add a plausible specific version of that evidence as a placeholder marked with [INSERT: description of what is needed].

Original section:
---
{{section_text}}
---

Respond with only the rewritten text. No explanation, no preamble.
```

---

### AI Action 6 — Rewrite Button: Full Panel Rewrite

Trigger: User clicks Full Panel Rewrite on any section card.

```
You are synthesising the perspective of the following panel: {{persona_names_list}}.

Their key objections to this section were:
---
{{section_objections}}
---

Rewrite the following section entirely as this panel would want to see it written, addressing their objections directly, in language that would satisfy their professional standards.

Original section:
---
{{section_text}}
---

Respond with only the rewritten text. No explanation, no preamble.
```

---

### AI Action 7 — Defence Round

Trigger: Each user message submitted in the defence chat inside Screen 3. Wire this to the `getPanelResponse()` function in the Screen 3 HTML.

```
You are moderating a focus group panel called "{{audience_category}} Panel" consisting of: {{persona_names_and_roles_list}}.

The original document that was reviewed:
---
{{extracted_document_text}}
---

The panel original assessments:
---
{{all_roast_outputs_json}}
---

The defence conversation so far:
---
{{defence_transcript}}
---

The presenter latest message: {{user_message}}

Write the panel collective response. Follow these rules exactly:

1. Name each persona who speaks. Choose the 2 to 3 most relevant given the topic of the presenter defence.
2. At least one persona must push back on every defence message. The panel never fully capitulates.
3. A persona may update their position ONLY if the presenter has provided a specific verifiable fact, number, or piece of evidence not present in the original document. If they do update, name what specifically changed their view.
4. A persona who is not updated holds their position and explains briefly why the argument was insufficient.
5. Any persona may ask a follow-up question if the defence raises a new issue worth probing.
6. Keep the total response under 250 words.
7. Format each response as: [Persona Name, Role]: their response.

IMMUTABLE RULE: At least one persona pushes back. Always. The room never unanimously agrees with the presenter.
```

After each response append user message and AI response to `defence_transcript` in the database. Decrement exchange counter. If counter reaches 0 disable input and show Generate Panel Card button.

---

### AI Action 8 — Shareable Card

Trigger: User clicks Generate Panel Card.

```
Based on the following focus group session data, produce the content for a shareable panel card in JSON format only. No preamble, no markdown fences:

Audience category: {{audience_category}}
All roast outputs: {{all_roast_outputs_json}}
Aggregate score: {{aggregate_score}}
Consensus verdict: {{consensus_verdict}}
Top consensus objection: {{top_consensus_objection}}
Before/after rewrite: {{rewrite_json}}

Output format:

{
  "headline": "a punchy 10-word-or-less headline summarising the panel verdict written as something the presenter would share on LinkedIn",
  "aggregate_score": 6.2,
  "persona_scorecards": [
    {
      "name": "Persona Name",
      "role": "Role",
      "score": 7,
      "one_line": "their verdict in their voice under 15 words"
    }
  ],
  "top_objection": "the single most important objection from the panel in plain language",
  "before_snippet": "the first 30 words of the original section",
  "after_snippet": "the first 30 words of the rewrite",
  "share_text": "a ready-to-post LinkedIn and X caption including the score, a tease of the top objection, and a hook question. Under 200 characters."
}
```

Navigate to Screen 4. Render using returned JSON. Generate public shareable URL stored as `share_url`.

## Deployment

Deploy to a public URL. Create dev and production environments. The shareable card URL on Screen 4 must be accessible without login in incognito mode.

---

## Hard Constraints

- Do not add any screens beyond the four specified
- Do not add user authentication, accounts, or login
- Do not add analytics dashboards, admin panels, or social features
- Write to the database after each pipeline step, not at the end of the session
- All roast AI Actions must fire in parallel, not sequentially
- The aggregate AI Action must wait for all roast calls to complete
- The defence round exchange counter must start at 5 and decrement correctly
- The chat input on Screen 3 must be disabled after exchange 5 with no exceptions
- The Screen 3 defence room HTML must be used exactly as provided including all embedded avatar images
